DSOAL r697 + OpenAL Soft r10817, 32-bit (Win32), unmodified.
From https://github.com/kcat/dsoal/releases/tag/latest-master (DSOAL_r697.zip, DSOAL/Win32).
Kept here because that download link always points at the newest build; releases
ship exactly the versions that were tested. Licences and source links:
licenses/DSOAL-*.txt and licenses/OpenALSoft-*.txt.
source/: git archive of both at the shipped commits (DSOAL r697 e111282, OpenAL Soft r10817 9ca7d05; commit
counts and the hashes inside the DLLs match), packaged into the release's licenses\source.
